name: Lazygit
description: Git UI for the current folder

name: Gitu
description: Git client for the current folder

name: llmtrim
command: fish -c 'llmtrim status'; printf '\nPress Enter to close'; read -r _

name: Yazi
description: File manager for the current folder

name: Changes
command: herdr-app do pane.split "{\"direction\":\"right\",\"mod\":\"changes-pane\",\"props\":{\"folder\":\"$PWD\"}}" && herdr-app do pane.zoom

name: Git Graph
description: Open the git graph as a pane
command: herdr-app do pane.split "{\"direction\":\"right\",\"mod\":\"git-graph\",\"props\":{\"folder\":\"$PWD\"}}" && herdr-app do pane.zoom
